artifacts.notes: Whole 181-page PDF: one Bonn identification sheet and 180 scanned page images, matching the 180 IIIF canvases. Title, permissions, anaphora openings and final text page were sampled; no complete collation is claimed.
artifacts.rights_basis: The anonymous official Ge’ez book carries the Ethiopian imprint year 1907, corresponding to 1914/15, and earlier 1913 approval and imprimatur dates. It is public domain in the United States by publication date. Bonn ULB marks this exact title (https://digitale-sammlungen.ulb.uni-bonn.de/content/titleinfo/3222909) Public Domain Mark 1.0. Retain the unchanged 181-page provider PDF with Bonn attribution; do not treat the 1913 approval as a separate printing or assert identity with Keren 1890.
